notes: Borough accepted DCA obligation of 155 prospective need, 0 present need. VLA shows no parcels meeting 0.83-acre threshold; RDP = 0, Unmet Need = 155. Fourth Round sites (Table 21): (1) 577 Godwin Ave (Block 41, Lot 2) — 6 total / 1 affordable, completed; (2) Nouvelle LLC / 714 Godwin Ave (Block 55, Lot 8) — 5 units 100% affordable veterans housing, completed (amended Oct 2024); (3) 90 Midland Ave MARD (Block 45, Lot 9.01) — 28 total / 5 affordable, 15-20% set-aside, Ord #14-2024 adopted Oct 10, 2024; (4) Block 22 Site — 23 total / 4 affordable, proposed MFO-3 overlay, 18 du/ac, 1.33 acres. Third Round carried forward: MFO-1 and MFO-2 overlay zones; 72 Lake Ave (Block 3, Lot 2) — 6 units / 1 affordable (approved 2018). Total identified Fourth Round affordable units only = ~15 vs 155 obligation; significant shortfall addressed via mandatory set-aside ordinance.
